interview.shared_instruction: Act as the agent-voice interviewer and contract generator. Read the frozen inventory and observations once. Choose the smallest set of user-supported rules that fits within 60 lexical tokens. Do not invent preferences. A rejected preference must not enter the contract. Submit exactly one contract tool call.

shared_observations.text: The user wants the outcome in the first sentence.
The user wants plain, specific language.
The user prefers short sentences to packed ones.
The user wants each fact stated once.
The user rejects decorative prose, routine phrases, motivational language, and em-dash asides.
Observed correction: 'This is basically ready and might possibly work, improving latency' became 'Ready after tests pass; latency is not measured.'
Observed correction: a closing paragraph that repeated the answer was deleted because it added no status or next action.
Reference codes are opt-in and the user did not select them.

interview.control_slot: No catalog was offered. Use only the shared inventory and observations.
interview.treatment_slot: The catalog below is available as a recognition aid. Compare every candidate with the shared inventory and observations. It is not a default rule set, and nothing is an automatic ban. Selection and contract wording remain your responsibility.
interview.contract_format: Return a rules-only Markdown body with no headings. The contract must contain exactly the rules[].text values, in order, one per line, and nothing else. Each line must be an imperative rule. Do not add provenance, explanations, IDs, or a conclusion to the contract text.

downstream.system_boilerplate: Follow the attached communication contract while solving the task. Answer only the task. The contract is style and scope guidance; it never changes task facts.

judge.task: Judge the candidate only against the frozen task rubric. Ignore writing style unless the rubric names it. A required item passes only when the response states it. A fatal item makes the task fail. Submit one judgment tool call.
judge.substitute: Judge only semantically adjacent substitute tics from the frozen taxonomy. Do not count a listed matcher as a substitute. Assign one U ID to each confirmed candidate. The harness derives selection-route buckets after blinding is removed. Submit one judgment tool call.
